title: Open the Coffer
description: Fathoms has a native milestone for opening one of its coffers. Follow that mechanism to the end and bring the Historian a result from something the depths kept sealed.
description_completed: The coffer is open. Whatever else the deeper waters conceal, you now have direct proof that their contents can be reached.

dialogue.offer: Catches are only part of the record. Find a coffer from these waters, open it by the proper method, then return.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: Opened, then. Good. A sealed object tells us more than another rumor ever could.
dialogue.completed: The coffer is accounted for. The catalogue is next.
